speaker: A
text: So last year we were a team of six, and honestly, we were drowning in busywork.

speaker: A
text: We let AI handle the boring parts. Reports, tickets, first drafts. Within three months we saved about 40% of our week.

speaker: B
text: Forty percent. That's huge. But didn't quality drop?

speaker: A
text: That was my biggest fear. The opposite happened. People finally had time to think, and our revenue doubled.
